norman_sicily founded set to 1059 (papal grant of duchy of Apulia at Melfi) rather than canonical 1071, because the entity appears from the 1066 slice; kingdom-of-1130 noted. cilician_armenia likewise uses 1080 (Rubenid principality) vs canonical 1198 (kingdom).

Dalmatia (DAL) oscillates: Croatia 930 (Tomislav) → Byzantium 960-1054 → Croatia 1066 (Krešimir IV) → Venice 1130 → Hungary 1154 → Byzantium 1180 (Manuel's conquest 1167-80; Hungary retakes 1181). Every step defensible but the cities changed hands even more often.
Bosnia (BOS): Croatia 930-1066, Duklja-Serbia 1095 (Bodin), Hungary 1130-1154 (bans Borić etc.), own banate under Kulin at 1180 (founded 1154 to match era09).

Provence (PRO): kingdom of Burgundy/Arles to 1016, imperial (HRE) 1054-1130 after the 1032 inheritance, then assigned to the Crown of Aragon 1154-1180 reflecting the Barcelona dynasty's county (held since 1112) despite nominal imperial suzerainty — matches era09's 1204 assignment.

Portugal appears only from 1154 (kingdom 1139); at 1130 POR_N is kept under Castile-León flagged contested even though Afonso Henriques was de facto independent from 1128. POR_S given to Portugal at 1180 (Évora held since 1165) though Beja was contested — flagged contested.

ARM/ARM_W after 1071 are simplified: one 'armenian_emirates' entity lumps Shah-Armens, Saltukids and Shaddadid Ani (1154-1180); at 1130 ARM is given to Georgia (Shaddadids as vassals after Ani 1124, re-enfeoffed 1126) flagged contested.
Cherson kept Crimea (CRM) Byzantine throughout although the steppe interior was Pecheneg/Cuman; the coastal theme is what the sources attest.
Skåne was Danish throughout, but the SWE_S cell centroid lies in Götaland so the whole cell is assigned to Sweden (as era09 does at 1204).
EST assigned to finnic_peoples (Estonians are Finnic); era09's 1204 slice groups EST under balts_early, so the merge will show a spurious culture flip there.
MAR/RIF at 987 given to the Cordoban Amirid regime (Fez under Umayyad clients from the 980s); the western Maghreb was really a patchwork of Zenata client emirs.

1016 al-Andalus kept as one collapsing entity (fitna 1009-31, caliphate formally alive); taifas entity used from 1054. VAL 1095 given to El Cid's personal lordship; VAL 1154 to Ibn Mardanish's Murcia-Valencia emirate.

SYR cell straddles Aleppo and Damascus, usually under different rulers (Hamdanid/Fatimid 987; Mirdasid/Fatimid 1054-66; Zengi/Burid 1130; Zengid/Ayyubid 1180): assigned to the stronger power and flagged contested at those slices.
Fatimid hold on ARB (Hejaz fringe) 987-1154 reflects the khutba in Mecca, which in fact oscillated between Cairo and Baghdad.
Population figures interpolate McEvedy & Jones-style anchors (Europe ~38M in 1000, ~48M in 1100, ~58M in 1180); entity-level numbers are honest best estimates, not precise counts.
